🎥🎬: Jawbreaker (1999)

On prom night, popular high-school girls Courtney, Julie, Marcie, and Liz plan a cruel prank for Liz’s birthday. But when the joke goes horribly wrong, the girls are terrified that their perfect reputations will be destroyed.

Courtney takes control of the situation and convinces the others to help cover up what happened. When Fern Mayo discovers their secret, Courtney sees an opportunity to turn the unpopular girl into the school’s new social star in exchange for her silence.

But as popularity, jealousy, and betrayal take over, the girls’ carefully constructed lie begins falling apart. Courtney’s obsession with staying on top pushes everyone around her toward a dangerous confrontation.

source_details.synopsis: Jawbreaker is a 1999 American black comedy crime film written and directed by Darren Stein. Starring Rose McGowan, Rebecca Gayheart, Julie Benz, Judy Greer, Chad Christ, Ethan Erickson, Carol Kane, and Pam Grier, the film follows the "Flawless Four", the most popular girls at Reagan High School, who cover up the killing of fellow member Elizabeth "Liz" Purr after a kidnapping prank on her 17th birthday goes awry. When Fern Mayo (Greer) encounters the trio staging a crime scene with her body, Courtney Shayne (McGowan) and Marcie "Foxy" Fox (Benz) blackmail her into joining them, causing Julie Freeman (Gayheart) to question her place within the clique.
